<?php
require_once 'wordpress/wp-load.php';
$dir = WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/mu-plugins';
if ( ! is_dir( $dir ) ) {
	wp_mkdir_p( $dir );
}
$file = $dir . '/blockparty-button-icon-playground-kses.php';
$mu_plugin = <<<'MUPLUGIN_EOF'
<?php
/**
 * WordPress Playground: extend KSES for Blockparty Button Icon demo markup.
 */
add_filter( 'wp_kses_allowed_html', function( $tags, $context ) {
	if ( 'post' !== $context ) {
		return $tags;
	}

	if ( ! isset( $tags['div'] ) ) {
		$tags['div'] = array();
	}
	$tags['div']['style']       = true;
	$tags['div']['aria-hidden'] = true;
	$tags['div']['class']       = true;

	if ( ! isset( $tags['span'] ) ) {
		$tags['span'] = array();
	}
	$tags['span']['class'] = true;

	if ( ! isset( $tags['a'] ) ) {
		$tags['a'] = array();
	}
	$tags['a']['href']      = true;
	$tags['a']['class']     = true;
	$tags['a']['target']    = true;
	$tags['a']['rel']       = true;
	$tags['a']['data-type'] = true;
	$tags['a']['data-id']   = true;

	return $tags;
}, 10, 2 );
MUPLUGIN_EOF;
file_put_contents( $file, $mu_plugin );
echo file_exists( $file ) ? 'mu-plugin installed' : 'mu-plugin failed';
